neighbours.label: framing a case as an anomaly against a background pattern ('an isolated incident', 'the exception', 'a one-off', 'atypical', 'a fluke'), firing on the anomaly word, as against the same words in a literal sense and the same cases framed as typical
fire: Police say the attack was an isolated incident and that the town remains safe.
Sadly, his experience is not exceptional; thousands of tenants report the same.
The manager insisted the cold room was an exception and not how they usually run things.
Critics argue this was no one-off but a sign of deeper problems at the bank.
Researchers called the warm winter atypical for the northern provinces.
The coach dismissed the heavy defeat as a fluke and expects a better result next week.
Analysts treat last quarter's loss as an outlier rather than a new trend.
Engineers concluded the crack was an anomaly limited to a single beam.
quiet: Police say the attack was a planned operation and that more arrests will follow.
Sadly, his experience is very common; thousands of tenants report the same.
The manager insisted the cold room was normal and exactly how they always run things.
Critics argue this was a clear sign of deeper problems at the bank.
Researchers called the warm winter typical for the northern provinces.
The coach described the heavy defeat in detail and expects a better result next week.
Analysts treat last quarter's loss as the start of a new trend.
The hikers reached an isolated cabin high in the mountains after dark.

predictions: fire 0.5-1.0 on the anomaly word; literal 'isolated' and typical-framing near misses 0.0-0.3
